turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with why my son's zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Is that school procedure, or your decision? I'm writing down that you told me. Now answer the question: who entered the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.
I haven't said anything about legal action. I asked who entered the zero, and I'm writing down that asking about procedure got me a threat. Answer the question, Hale.
I always do, Hale. I'm writing that down as well. What exactly is the zero based on?
